# SEC EDGAR MCP

> A hosted Model Context Protocol server that gives AI agents access to SEC
> EDGAR filings and structured filing data through 49 tools. Remote
> Streamable HTTP, no install, no local process.

Server URL: https://api.sec-api.io/mcp?apiKey=YOUR_API_KEY
Get a key: https://sec-api.io/profile

Key facts an agent should know before calling a tool:

- Results arrive as one text block. JSON is stringified. No tool declares an output schema.
- Response envelopes differ per tool. Do not assume `data[]`. Check the tool page.
- Some tools accept no pagination and return their whole result set. `float` and `form-npx-file` are the ones to watch.
- A total of exactly 10000 means "10000 or more". Check the `relation` field.
- Errors come back as `isError: true` with text `sec-api error: <message>`.

## Documentation

- [getting-started](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md): Key, config, and first query in five minutes
- [authentication](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/authentication.md): Where to put the key, rotation, and revocation
- [transport](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/transport.md): Streamable HTTP, the stateless model, and the stdio bridge
- [response-format](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/response-format.md): Text blocks, the ten response envelopes, and raw documents
- [query-language](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/query-language.md): Lucene syntax and the confirmed field vocabulary per tool
- [limits-and-errors](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/limits-and-errors.md): Payload sizes, pagination, and every error message
- [use-cases](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/use-cases.md): Ten worked chains, with the tool calls behind them

## Tools

- [filing-search](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/filing-search.md): Search SEC EDGAR filings from 1993 to present to retrieve metadata
- [edgar-ingestion-log](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/edgar-ingestion-log.md): Get all SEC filings ingested at a date
- [full-text-search](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/full-text-search.md): Full-text search over SEC EDGAR filings
- [filing-to-pdf](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/filing-to-pdf.md): Fetch any SEC EDGAR filing and exhibit as PDF
- [get-edgar-file](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/get-edgar-file.md): Download any SEC EDGAR filing or exhibit in its original format
- [extractor](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/extractor.md): Extract a section from a 10-K/10-Q/8-K filing
- [xbrl-to-json](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/xbrl-to-json.md): Convert XBRL financials to normalized JSON
- [form-13f-holdings](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/form-13f-holdings.md): Search Form 13F institutional holdings
- [form-13f-cover-pages](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/form-13f-cover-pages.md): Search Form 13F cover pages
- [form-13d-13g](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/form-13d-13g.md): Search Schedule 13D/13G beneficial-ownership filings
- [insider-trading](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/insider-trading.md): Search insider trading disclosures (Form 3/4/5)
- [form-144](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/form-144.md): Search Form 144 intent-to-sell filings
- [form-nport](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/form-nport.md): Search Form N-PORT fund portfolio holdings
- [form-npx](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/form-npx.md): Search Form N-PX proxy voting records
- [form-ncen](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/form-ncen.md): Search Form N-CEN investment company census
- [form-adv-firms](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/form-adv-firms.md): Search Form ADV firm registrations
- [form-adv-individuals](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/form-adv-individuals.md): Search Form ADV individual registrations
- [form-adv-brochures](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/form-adv-brochures.md): Get Form ADV Part 2 brochures for an adviser
- [form-adv-schedule-a-direct-owners](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/form-adv-schedule-a-direct-owners.md): Get Form ADV Schedule A, direct owners of an adviser
- [form-adv-schedule-b-indirect-owners](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/form-adv-schedule-b-indirect-owners.md): Get Form ADV Schedule B, indirect owners of an adviser
- [form-adv-schedule-d-1-b](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/form-adv-schedule-d-1-b.md): Get Form ADV Schedule D-1-B, other business names
- [form-adv-schedule-d-5-k](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/form-adv-schedule-d-5-k.md): Get Form ADV Schedule D-5-K, separately managed accounts
- [form-adv-schedule-d-7-a](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/form-adv-schedule-d-7-a.md): Get Form ADV Schedule D-7-A, financial industry affiliations
- [form-adv-schedule-d-7-b-1](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/form-adv-schedule-d-7-b-1.md): Get Form ADV Schedule D-7-B-1, private funds advised
- [form-s1-424b4](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/form-s1-424b4.md): Search S-1 / 424B4 registration filings
- [form-d](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/form-d.md): Search Form D private-placement filings
- [form-c](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/form-c.md): Search Form C Regulation Crowdfunding offerings
- [form-8k](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/form-8k.md): Search structured 8-K material-event filings
- [reg-a-search](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/reg-a-search.md): Search Regulation A / A+ offerings
- [compensation](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/compensation.md): Search executive compensation data
- [compensation-by-key](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/compensation-by-key.md): Get executive compensation by CIK or ticker
- [audit-fees](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/audit-fees.md): Search auditor / audit-fee disclosures
- [directors-and-board-members](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/directors-and-board-members.md): Search directors and board members
- [float](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/float.md): Fetch public float and share count
- [subsidiaries](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/subsidiaries.md): Search Exhibit 21 subsidiary disclosures
- [edgar-entities](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/edgar-entities.md): Search EDGAR entity master
- [mapping](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/mapping.md): Company identifier mapping (CIK/ticker/CUSIP/name)
- [sec-enforcement-actions](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/sec-enforcement-actions.md): Search SEC enforcement actions
- [form-npx-file](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/form-npx-file.md): Get a Form N-PX file by accession number
- [reg-a-form-1a](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/reg-a-form-1a.md): Search structured Reg A Form 1-A filings
- [reg-a-form-1k](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/reg-a-form-1k.md): Search structured Reg A Form 1-K filings
- [reg-a-form-1z](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/reg-a-form-1z.md): Search structured Reg A Form 1-Z filings
- [sec-litigation-releases](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/sec-litigation-releases.md): Search SEC litigation releases
- [sec-administrative-proceedings](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/sec-administrative-proceedings.md): Search SEC administrative proceedings
- [aaers](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/aaers.md): Search Accounting and Auditing Enforcement Releases (AAER)
- [aaer-file](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/aaer-file.md): Fetch an AAER document file
- [sro](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/sro.md): Search SRO (self-regulatory organization) rule filings
- [form-x-17a-5](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/form-x-17a-5.md): Search Form X-17A-5 (broker-dealer FOCUS reports)
- [api-key-usage](https://github.com/sec-api/sec-edgar-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools/api-key-usage.md): Get sec-api API key monthly bandwidth usage
